title: dbr pages/<name>/visuals/<visual>.yml
description: One visual. `type` selects which factory in VISUAL_REGISTRY renders it; `encoding` binds channels (x, y, color, size, value, category, rows, columns) to either {dimension: <name>} or {metric: <name>}. Per-visual schemas (registered in VISUAL_SCHEMAS) define the mandatory channels and option fields for each type.

type.description: Visual type — must be a key in VISUAL_REGISTRY. The allowed set is enforced at validate time from the live registry.

encoding.description: Channel bindings. Each channel binds to a dimension or a metric. Allowed channels and which are mandatory depend on the visual type — see the per-visual schema (in VISUAL_SCHEMAS).

title.description: Optional header text rendered at the top of the visual card.

subtitle.description: Optional smaller caption rendered below the title.

drill_through.description: Clicking a data point navigates to target_page and applies the clicked value as a filter on linked visuals.

pass_filter.description: Map filter key → dimension column name to extract from clickData.

cross_filter.description: When true, clicking a data point in this chart emits a filter signal to all visuals with matching filter_from bindings. The clicked value is used as the filter.

cross_filter_dimension.description: The dimension key emitted when cross_filter is true. Must match the filter_from dimension key on receiver charts.

filter_from.description: Wires this visual to one or more slicer visuals on the same page. Keys are slicer_id values; values are the filter dimension key. E.g. { country_filter: geo }.

filter.description: Filter passed to the semantic layer. Keys are entity/dimension names; values are scalars or arrays.

options.description: Per-visual behaviour overrides. Allowed keys depend on the visual type.
